meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会遍历仓库全部 open issue 和 PR,每条开一个后台任务做只读分析,把结论写成文件放到 /tmp/{日期}/ 目录,每条论断都附 GitHub permalink 作为证据。它不在 GitHub 上做任何操作:不评论、不合并、不关闭、不打标签。
howto.when: 当你说出 “triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs” 等触发词,想对当前仓库已开启的 issue 和 PR 做分诊分析时,它就会接管。

say.note: 逐条只读审查 open PR 并生成报告文件
issue 与 PR 一起分析,全部只读不改动

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude walks every open issue and PR, spawns one background task per item, and writes reports with GitHub permalink evidence into /tmp/{datetime}/. It is read-only: no comments, merges, closes, or labels.
howto.when_en: Triggers on “triage”, “triage issues”, “triage PRs” etc., i.e. when you want open issues and PRs triaged read-only in the current repo.

say_en.note: Analyzes every open issue; reports go to a timestamped /tmp dir
Read-only review of each open PR, one report file per PR
Handles issues and PRs together, read-only throughout
